behavior: AC1: Two concurrency scopes in pr-agent.yml — per-PR workflow group that cancels, repository-wide job lane with queue: max — and the queue key is not beside a cancelling group
verification: uv run pytest tests/test_pr_agent_workflow.py -k 'queued or supersession or queue' -q

behavior: AC2: The PR-Agent step declares a timeout strictly below the job bound, so a hung attempt releases the lane
AC3: The publish guard is gated on !cancelled(), so a superseded run reports no missing review
AC4: A burst of four pull requests each receive a review — machine proxy: a four-plus run bucket that is neither cancelled nor failed; the published Guide per PR is confirmed by hand
verification: gh run list --workflow=pr-agent.yml --limit 40 --json event,createdAt,conclusion | jq -e '([.[] | select(.event=="pull_request")] | group_by(.createdAt[0:13]) | any(.[]; length >= 4)) and ([.[] | select(.conclusion=="failure" or .conclusion=="cancelled")] | length == 0)'
